title: wsteth-2.0 chain config
description: Shared per-chain format for the CCIP deploy scripts. Field provenance depends on the operation: an in-place upgrade takes the existing token and DAO principal as observed inputs; a scratch deployment records them as outputs. Lane topology and intended governance role holders are authored inputs. The lint-config recipe checks this schema and operation-specific template rules.

token.description: Existing token input for in-place-upgrade; generated output for scratch-deployment (address(0) in a scratch template). The hub records its core token; 1_Deploy creates the spoke token from token_deployment.

ccip.description: L — external CCIP facts for this chain (Chainlink-fixed). Committed; FFI-refreshable by 1_Deploy.

pool_type.description: L — L1 hub = SiloedLockRelease; L2 spoke = BurnMint.

governance_addresses.description: Intended lane role holders are authored inputs. lido_dao_agent is an existing principal for in-place-upgrade or a deployed principal for scratch-deployment. deployer is recorded from deployment CREATE receipts.

emergency_brakes.description: D — timelock canceller + proposal-queue halter, hooks pauser.

lido_dao_agent.description: Existing L1 Agent / L2 executor input for in-place-upgrade; generated output for scratch-deployment (zero in a scratch template).

deployer.description: E — absent in a template; step 04 stamps the signer of the CREATE records (whose admin roles step 07 hands over).

token_deployment.description: D — scratch spokes only (BurnMint, addresses.token = address(0)): the wstETH token 1_Deploy deploys (ERC20BridgedPermit behind a TransparentUpgradeableProxy whose ProxyAdmin lido_dao_agent owns). version is the EIP-712 signing-domain version.

remote_lanes.description: D — authored lane topology. Lanes that are not siloed share one lock box; each siloed lane gets its own. A target template lists the spokes of the target; the hub-inventory step appends the lanes the hub takes over from an existing pool (see imported_lanes) and lists the target spokes under deferred_lanes.

imported_lanes.description: D/L — lanes the hub takes over from an existing pool, keyed by remote_chain_name (each also in remote_lanes). Written by the hub-inventory step from the replaced pool at a pinned block; absent in a template. 2_Configure applies these remote pools and limits instead of the defaults and configures no CCVs for the lane (required_ccvs is always none).

imported.description: L — marks a spoke record the hub-inventory step wrote for a lane taken over from an existing pool: the spoke is not deployed by the run and the record carries only what 2_Configure reads (ccip, addresses.token, deployed.token_pool).

deployed.description: E — written by 1_Deploy; absent in a pristine template. token/token_impl/token_proxy_admin only when 1_Deploy deployed the token.

ccv.description: E — written by 1_Deploy; absent in a pristine template.

deferred_lanes.description: D — lanes our ConfigureHubForMigration leaves unconfigured for the pool owner (each also in remote_lanes, none imported): their lock box is deployed, authorized and handed over, but the chain update, fee config, lock box binding, hooks CCV entry and verifier/resolver entries are applied later by a LidoTimelock proposal (our BuildHubLaneProposal builds the calls; the hub-connect-lane step replays it on a fork). Written by the hub-inventory step for the target spokes of a hub that takes over an existing pool; absent otherwise.
